title: Lower Meadows / Band 1: leave village -> pond -> optional detour -> South Bridge fight -> cross
_comment: Transcribed from ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section B (span), section D (RT-03, RT-04, RT-05), section E.1 (CB-04's band 1 fight, south_bridge_grunt at (14,1314)), section E.5 (objective `head_to_south_bridge`), section G (GF-05-MEADOW-01, GF-06-POND-01/02, GF-07-BRIDGE-01/02, GF-18-MAP-03, GF-19-UI-08, GF-21-WEATHER-02, GF-14-COMBAT-04a) and section H (0.1 Hz plus the band handoff window).
_comment_detour: AMBIGUITY: section B's span names an 'optional detour' between the pond and the South Bridge and never says which one. Section L.4 names old_champion_bram (195,905) as the journey's representative optional trainer, and data/config/map_landmarks.json puts the Trail Camp at (348,919.5) on the same corridor bend; both are transcribed below as that detour, and the choice is recorded as the transcriber's rather than the protocol's.
_comment_long_walks: The three legs here are the chapter's first long ones (village->pond ~600 m, pond->bridge ~900 m). budget_frames is sized from the distance at the walking rate the self-check measured on this box; held_budget_frames is raised so a wild encounter en route pauses the walk instead of aborting it, and the FAIL message names the input_context that held it if it never comes back.
_comment_evidence_lane: §H/§G evidence split, owner decision 2026-08-27, recorded in ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md §H.1. This is the LOGIC lane: the journey run headless for mechanics, telemetry and step verdicts at 6.1 ms/frame against 12,721 ms for a rendered frame on the Gate F container. It takes no prescribed frame; the §G ids its steps would have taken are DELEGATED to S05C, which declares each of them in its "owes" list. The harness refuses to start this segment if S05C does not exist, does not declare evidence_lane=capture, or does not accept every id handed to it -- a delegation nobody accepted is a debt that has quietly stopped existing, which is the same shape as the 9,231 file:null PASSes CD-1 was written for. Whether the debt was actually PAID is a question about the whole run directory and is answered by tools/gate_f/run_inventory.py, not here.
_comment_record_hz_split: AMENDED for the §H/§G evidence split. record_hz is forced to 0 on a logic lane by the harness regardless of what this file says, because §H's continuous record is the thing the split removes: the recorder's cadence is counted in PLAY seconds now, but under a 12.7 s rendered frame even a 0.1 Hz record fires on every rendered frame, and the eighteen segments' 4,607,802 physics frames are ~8,283 hours. The obligation is not dropped -- §H's prescribed frames move to S05C, which may run BOUNDED record windows around a named state.

args.text: Section H: 'Mandatory for the highest-risk segments: ... every band handoff +/-60 s (region transitions)'. The pairs in this segment raise the background recorder from the 0.1 Hz journey baseline to 0.5 Hz across each band boundary this segment crosses, and `record_stop` returns to the baseline rather than switching the recorder off, so the record stays continuous either side. steps._comment_route: RIG-F6, ralph/GATE-F-FULL 2026-08-30. S05-19 walked straight from the tournament ground to (-40,180) and the straight line crosses the village outline at (16.6, 21.5), 37.6 m from the nearest gate. `data/config/village_boundary.json` gave the village a closed fence on 2026-08-30 (OP-0830-1, then the straddle fix the same day) and `village_boundary.gd` builds it as sealed StaticBody3D panels with a hole only at each gate, so the walk hit a wall: measured, `did not reach (-40, 180) in 11700 walking frames; stopped 155.8 m short at (-15.0, 1.0, 26.0)` -- which is the outline's own [-15,27] vertex, 22 m from PondGate. The next walk then failed identically from the same spot, and every walk after it would have. NOT A GAME DEFECT: `road_gate_open` is set from S02 and `village_boundary.gd` swings BOTH gates on that flag, so a player following the Pond road out of the village leaves freely -- `terrain_playground.json`'s third route is exactly (10,-10) -> (-14,14) -> (-45,45) -> (-105,115), through PondGate at (-21,21). This segment predates the fence and was still walking as though the village had no edge. Split into three legs that follow the road the player follows: to the gate, through it, then on to the spine. Checked against the outline before authoring -- the only crossing on the three legs is the gate itself.
